subject.title: [Feature Request] Show usage percentage and time until reset together

question: Should CodexBar add an opt-in combined percentage-and-reset-time menu-bar mode, initially limited to compact text?
rationale: This adds a user-facing display and configuration choice, and VISION.md requires sign-off for new features even though existing formatter and metric-selection seams can support it.

options.title: Add compact text
options.body: Add a mode such as `69% · 3h 35m` using existing window selection and reset formatting with a defined percentage-only fallback.

options.title: Design pace marker
options.body: Implement the richer bar-and-time-marker visualization, accepting greater width, rendering, and maintenance complexity.

options.title: Keep modes separate
options.body: Retain the current mutually exclusive percentage and reset-time modes without another setting.

recommendation.title: Add compact text
recommendation.body: Add a mode such as `69% · 3h 35m` using existing window selection and reset formatting with a defined percentage-only fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner made and merged the adjacent reset-time display decision.
